sloka: स तत्तदा भग्नमवेक्ष्य शूलं चुकोप रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा।उत्पाट्य लङ्कामलयात् स शृङ्गं जघान सुग्रीवमुपेत्य तेन ।। ६.६७.६७ ।।
transliteration: sa tattadā bhagnamavekṣya śūlaṁ cukopa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā।utpāṭya laṅkāmalayāt sa śṛṅgaṁ jaghāna sugrīvamupetya tena ।। 6.67.67 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa was dismayed and mellowed. The forest rangers rejoiced and roared like lions going round. Seeing the broken pike Vanaras applauded Hanuman.
